ticket.body: Thank you for your purchase. Your tickets for "%s" are attached to this email (PDF).

refund.routeGateway: The money goes back through %s, to the same method you paid with.
refund.routeUnknown: The money goes back to the same method you paid with.

invite.subject: Invitation: %s

invite.body: We are delighted to invite you to “{event}”. Your complimentary ticket is attached. Date: {date}. Address: {venue_address}.

pay.title: Ticket payment
pay.expired: The booking has expired. Please choose your tickets again.
pay.note: PDF tickets go to %s right after payment.
pay.secure: Card details are handled by Stripe. We never see or store them.

promo.applyFailed: The promo code could not be applied

thankyou.title: Payment successful
thankyou.text: Your tickets have been sent to the e-mail address you gave at checkout. If the letter does not arrive, check the spam folder.
thankyou.accountText: Your tickets are always at hand: besides the e-mail, you can download or re-send them from your account.
thankyou.shareText: Invite someone along — share the event.
thankyou.shareMessage: I am going to %s. Join me? %s
thankyou.failedText: No money was taken. You can try to pay again.

account.title: My account
account.intro: Enter the e-mail address you used for your order. We will send you a sign-in link.
account.linkSent: Check your inbox. If tickets exist for this address, a sign-in link is on its way.
account.empty: There are no paid tickets for this address yet.
account.sent: Tickets sent to %s. Check your inbox and the spam folder.
account.errBil24: Could not verify the tickets with the ticketing system. Please try again in a minute.

account.errCooldown: Tickets were sent recently — please try again in %d min.
